bullets.text: Velachery residents and PMK chief Anbumani Ramadoss demanded a permanent flood mitigation plan and the removal of the Pallikaranai wetland wall after heavy rains caused severe inundation.
In Thiruvallur and Uthukottai, heavy monsoon rains and six-lane highway works flooded 200 acres and residential areas, prompting the office to monitor rescue and relief operations closely.
Motorists faced dangerous conditions on Chennai and Thiruvallur roads due to waterlogging, uprooted trees, and delayed pipeline works, requiring continuous oversight by local response teams.
The Tamil Nadu government advanced DPR work for the 4 km elevated corridor from Chennai Lighthouse to Thiru.Vi.Ka. Bridge to ease Adyar traffic congestion, which the office should track.
Residents in the 174th ward of Adyar zone reported severe mosquito nuisance near the Velachery mall, requiring the office to direct civic authorities to take immediate sanitation action.
Differently abled individuals staged a protest in Ponneri demanding to be included in the Vetri Payana Thittam scheme, and the office should review the implementation of ministerial assurances.
Southern Railway is launching a 30-day AC suburban train trial connecting Moore Market Complex, Avadi, Thiruvallur, and Arakkonam, which the district team should monitor for commuter feedback.
Water levels in reservoirs supplying Chennai rose significantly due to continuous rain, and the office should maintain oversight on Puzhel lake inflow and flood warnings.
Vultr announced plans to build a 20 MW AI data center in Chennai using AMD Instinct GPUs, and the portfolio team should track this investment to boost regional cloud infrastructure.
The government planned to set up AI and robotics labs in government engineering colleges in Coimbatore, Salem, and Bargur, which the IT team should oversee for timely establishment.
IIT Madras Director V. Kamakoti emphasized promoting frugal AI and announced a upcoming white paper on AI jobs, guiding the office on aligning local policies with sustainable tech standards.
DMK leaders criticized the administration over the delay in finding a missing 7-year-old girl in Villupuram, and the constituency team should note the opposition's ongoing protests and statements.
MP Dharani Vendhan and other leaders publicly criticized the ruling administration regarding child safety and governance, which the political desk should monitor for media response.
